# homarr_user_preferences (Data Source)

Reads the preferences of a Homarr user: the read-only counterpart of the `homarr_user_preferences` resource, for any account, including those backed by LDAP or OIDC.

Where the resource spells a cleared reference as `""`, this data source reports `null`: `home_board_id`, `mobile_home_board_id` and `default_search_engine_id` are `null` when the user has none.

~> **Requires Homarr 2.3.0 or newer**, which added `GET /api/users/preferences`. On an older release `user_id` must be set: the preferences are then read from `GET /api/users/{id}` instead, and `header`, which only the newer endpoint reports, is `null`, with a warning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without user_id, the preferences of the user behind the API key, which any
# key may read.
data "homarr_user_preferences" "me" {}

# Naming another user requires an admin key.
data "homarr_user" "jdoe" {
  username = "jdoe"
}

data "homarr_user_preferences" "jdoe" {
  user_id = data.homarr_user.jdoe.id
}

# Give a new account the same look as an existing one.
resource "homarr_user" "intern" {
  username         = "intern"
  password         = var.intern_password
  color_scheme     = data.homarr_user_preferences.jdoe.color_scheme
  byte_unit_system = data.homarr_user_preferences.jdoe.byte_unit_system
  header           = data.homarr_user_preferences.jdoe.header
}

output "my_home_board" {
  # null when the user has no home board.
  value = data.homarr_user_preferences.me.home_board_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the user whose preferences to read. Leave it out to read those of the user behind the API key, which any key may do; the attribute then reports that user's id. Naming another user requires an admin key.

### Read-Only

- `byte_unit_system` (String) How byte sizes are displayed: `binary` (KiB, MiB) or `decimal` (kB, MB).
- `color_scheme` (String) Interface colour scheme: `auto`, `light` or `dark`.
- `ddg_bangs` (Boolean) Whether DuckDuckGo-style `!bang` shortcuts work in the search bar.
- `default_search_engine_id` (String) Identifier of the search engine used by the search bar, or `null` for none.
- `enable_right_click_on_widgets` (Boolean) Whether widgets handle right-clicks instead of the browser context menu.
- `first_day_of_week` (Number) First day of the week in calendar widgets, `0` for Sunday through `6` for Saturday.
- `header` (Attributes) Layout of the header bar shown above boards. It has the shape the `header` attribute of `homarr_user` and `homarr_user_preferences` takes, so a layout read here can be copied onto another user.

~> **Requires Homarr 2.3.0 or newer.** On an older release it is `null`, and a warning says so. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header))
- `home_board_id` (String) Board shown to the user on desktop, or `null` for none.
- `id` (String) Same value as `user_id`, present because Terraform requires an `id`.
- `mobile_home_board_id` (String) Board shown to the user on mobile, or `null` for none.
- `open_search_in_new_tab` (Boolean) Whether search results open in a new browser tab.
- `ping_icons_enabled` (Boolean) Whether online-status ping indicators are shown as icons rather than dots.

<a id="nestedatt--header"></a>
### Nested Schema for `header`

Read-Only:

- `center` (Attributes List) Items in the center zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--center))
- `left` (Attributes List) Items in the left zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--left))
- `logo_display` (String) How the `logo` item is shown: `logo` or `logoAndText`.
- `right` (Attributes List) Items in the right zone, in display order; `[]` when it is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--header--right))
- `search_display` (String) How the `search` item is shown: `input` or `icon`.
- `visible` (Boolean) Whether the header is shown.

<a id="nestedatt--header--center"></a>
### Nested Schema for `header.center`

Read-Only:

- `board_id` (String) Identifier of the board linked to, or `null` for a builtin control.
- `builtin` (String) The builtin control, such as `logo`, `search` or `user`, or `null` for a board shortcut.


<a id="nestedatt--header--left"></a>

Read-Only:

- `board_id` (String) Identifier of the board linked to, or `null` for a builtin control.
- `builtin` (String) The builtin control, such as `logo`, `search` or `user`, or `null` for a board shortcut.

Read-Only:

- `board_id` (String) Identifier of the board linked to, or `null` for a builtin control.
- `builtin` (String) The builtin control, such as `logo`, `search` or `user`, or `null` for a board shortcut.
